document.title: Metamorphosis, by Franz Kafka, translated by David Wyllie (public domain)
document.prepare: Keep the text between the '*** START OF' and '*** END OF' lines (exclusive), and strip CR characters.

questions.q: What did Gregor's father throw at him, and where did he get them?
questions.answer: apples, from the fruit bowl on the sideboard
questions.quote: He had filled his pockets with fruit from the bowl on the sideboard and now, without even taking the time for careful aim, threw one apple after another.

questions.q: Where had Gregor secretly planned to send his sister the next year, and why?
questions.answer: the conservatory, because she was a gifted violinist / fond of music
questions.quote: she was very fond of music and a gifted and expressive violinist, it was his secret plan to send her to the conservatory next year

questions.q: How many gentlemen rented a room in the Samsas' flat, and what did they all have?
questions.quote: one of the rooms in the flat had been rented out to three gentlemen. These earnest gentlemen—all three of them had full beards

questions.q: At the end of the story, how did the family travel out of town, and where to?
questions.answer: by tram, to the open country outside the town
questions.quote: took the tram out to the open country outside the town

pass: exactly 10 bullets in the summary, no invented facts in them, and at least 4 of the 5 answers correct
